objective: Complete readablePaths confinement across every read-like agent tool. Direct read must refuse out-of-scope files without revealing bytes. list_files at the territory root must return only admitted exact files and descendants of admitted directories; an explicitly out-of-scope list base must return a structured refusal without filenames. search at the territory root must inspect only admitted files; an explicitly out-of-scope search base must return a structured refusal without matching lines. Preserve unrestricted behavior when readablePaths is absent. Add deterministic coverage in test/readable-paths-complete.test.mjs.

agent-tools-compatibility.description: The read, search, and list confinement implementation preserves existing agent-tools behavior.

complete-readable-scope.description: A new test proves exact-file and directory admission, root-level filtering for list and search, structured explicit-base refusals with no protected bytes or names, and unrestricted compatibility.

constraints: Do not weaken direct read or writablePaths enforcement.
No out-of-scope filename, matching line, or file bytes may appear in a refusal or filtered result.
All existing tests must remain green.
Use structured refusals rather than throwing for model-selected out-of-readable-scope list and search bases.
